notes.title: Release is thiiiiiiiiiiiiiis close
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone in this awesome community for encouraging me to continue to develop! I am very close to releasing the initial build.

The only block holding me back right now is finding a voice actress to play Aria. Right now, the voice used in the game is placeholder content -- it was AI generated to use only while I developed! Now that I'm so close, I've been looking for a real actress to give life to the character.

As soon as I find our VA, it's release time! 

This first build may have some problems, as I am only 1 lass -- I can't imagine I've found every bug! If you want to contribute before official release, hop into the community discord and sign up to be a playtester: https://discord.gg/cqWjnhrkUy
